hypotheses.statement: A backend-neutral typed canonical Relation node can serve as semantic identity while multiple validated surface forms lower into it without changing semantic_hash.
support: generic relation proxy 20,000/20,000 identity preservation from concurrent run
MLIR generic operation form with unique string operation names
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: One compact surface relation syntax should itself be canonical and no generic fallback is needed.
hypotheses.next_test: Implement canonical RelationId node in real BASE AST and roundtrip full G9+dialects from generic and one compact surface.

hypotheses.statement: The current @relation candidate is safe as a backend-neutral compact relation surface beside existing @ref.
support: concurrent relation-only @relation proxy parsed/resolved 8/8 with 12/12 mutation rejects
counterevidence: combined namespace proxy: LALR contextual 5/7, LALR basic 3/7, Earley dynamic 7/7; standalone @refs regress
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A lexically disjoint sigil or declared word syntax provides the same compactness without ref collision.
hypotheses.next_test: Only reconsider after production parser proves full-corpus @ref/@relation coexistence and backend-independent roundtrip.

hypotheses.statement: A finite declared relation registry can preserve compact human/machine-readable syntax while failing unknown relation words closed and lowering deterministically to canonical Relation IR.
support: concurrent declared relation resolver: 8/8 valid, 0/50,000 unknown accepts, 10,000/10,000 whitespace semantic-hash preservation
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Declared word operators create excessive parser/diagnostic/reader complexity compared with explicit generic calls.
hypotheses.next_test: Full-corpus production parser A/B against generic-only syntax; compare ambiguity, diagnostics, token/byte cost, Qwen reader accuracy and canonical hash stability.

hypotheses.statement: The immediate BASE blocker remains executable surface/parser/canonical-IR closure rather than missing FRANK-specific semantic primitives.
support: current release workspace 14/14 work packages OPEN
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A hidden semantic inadequacy will appear only in the complete adaptive learner or real applications.
hypotheses.next_test: Production parser -> typed IR -> type/effect -> lowering -> runtime over full learner and first Ubuntu applications.
